name: Bundle of long sticks
description: Five long barked sticks lashed together with cord at both ends and the middle.
notes: Five sticks 2.6 m long, three under two, with pale cut ends and three cord lashings. CHECK VOLUME (x2.8): the box counts the air round a round bundle; the sticks alone are about 25 L against the reference's 30 L. Untying it into five long sticks has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no long stick item to untie into. bark draws the sticks and cord-olive the lashings. The size is a placeholder for a thing too long for a pack.

name: Bundle of copper pipe
description: Ten lengths of copper water pipe tied together with cord.
notes: Ten hollow pipes 600 mm long and 22 mm across, packed three, four and three, their ends a little staggered, tied in two places. Untying it into ten pipes has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no copper pipe item. The size is a placeholder.

name: Bundle of steel pipe
description: Ten short lengths of steel pipe tied together with cord.
notes: Ten hollow pipes 600 mm long and 21 mm across with a thicker wall than the copper bundle, packed three, four and three and tied in two places. Untying it into ten pipes has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no pipe item. The size is a placeholder.

name: Bundle of rebar
description: Ten rusty steel reinforcing bars twisted together with tie wire.
notes: Ten bars 800 mm long and 16 mm across, packed three, four and three, ends staggered, with two wire ties. CHECK VOLUME (x2.4): the reference's 1.6 L is the steel; the box counts the air round a round bundle. The bars are drawn plain: ribs at the 2 mm grain were barely visible and multiplied the triangle count tenfold. scrap-rusted draws the bars. Untying it into ten bars has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no rebar item. The size is a placeholder.

name: Bundle of javelins
description: Five wooden javelins with fire-hardened points, lashed together with cord.
notes: Five shafts 1.4 m long and 24 mm across, three under two, all points one way, the points drawn darker as charred wood, with two cord lashings. Untying it into five javelins has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no javelin item. The size is a placeholder for a thing too long for a pack.

name: Bundle of planks
description: Ten sawn construction planks stacked two wide and five high, held by two steel straps.
notes: Planks 1220 mm long, 89 mm wide and 38 mm thick, the size that fits the reference's 41 L for ten. wood-pine and wood-birch alternate so each plank reads apart; steel-galvanised draws the straps and their seals. Untying it into ten planks has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no plank item. At 24 kg it is far from a pocket item; the size is a placeholder.

name: Bundle of cotton sheets
description: A tight stack of folded cotton sheets tied once each way with cord.
notes: Twenty-five sheets drawn as ten folded layers 200 by 150 mm, a little out of square, alternating cloth-cotton and paper-white so the layers read. Unpacking it into sheets has no content field yet. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Bundle of rags
description: A stack of folded cotton rags tied once each way with cord.
notes: A hundred patches drawn as eight folded layers 160 by 110 mm in mixed worn finishes. Unpacking it should give rag, the existing Deadvox item; that recipe has no content field until the drafts are applied. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Bundle of leather
description: A stack of leather patches tied once each way with cord.
notes: Fifty patches drawn as ten layers 140 by 100 mm, alternating leather-brown and skin-rawhide so the layers read. Unpacking it into patches has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no leather patch item. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Bundle of synthetic fabric
description: A stack of synthetic fabric patches in mixed colours, tied once each way with cord.
notes: Fifty patches drawn as six layers 100 by 80 mm in navy, olive, charcoal and red, as scrap offcuts come. Unpacking it into patches has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no synthetic fabric patch item. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Bundle of felt
description: A thick stack of grey felt patches tied once each way with cord.
notes: A hundred patches drawn as ten thick layers 140 by 110 mm. No felt finish exists: cloth-pants-grey and cloth-canvas alternate for it. Unpacking it into patches has no content field yet, and Deadvox has no felt patch item. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Candlestick
description: A polished brass candlestick with a turned stem, a wide drip pan and a deep socket for one candle.
notes: 280 mm tall on a foot 110 mm across, turned in one piece. CHECK VOLUME (x34): the reference's 100 ml is close to the brass itself (180 g of brass is about 21 ml), while the box counts the air round a tall thin stem; the drawn size matches the reference's longest side. brass stands in for the gold finish the reference mentions. Holding a lit candle has no content field yet.

name: Empty canister
description: An open steel canister painted olive with a yellow band, emptied of whatever it once held.
notes: 58 mm across and 110 mm tall, open at the top, with rolled steel rims and a bare steel floor that shows from above; about 190 ml inside against the reference's 263 ml. The olive paint and yellow band point at a spent gas canister. cooking stands for the reference's BOIL quality.

name: Cannabis plant
description: A whole cannabis plant pulled up by the root, with fan leaves along its stalk and a dense flowering top. Needs drying and trimming before use.
notes: Drawn lying on its side, 600 mm from root ball to tip, with six fan leaves of five or seven leaflets and a lumpy flowering top with small leaves. CHECK VOLUME (x10): the reference's 1 L is the plant pressed together; the box counts the spread leaves. plastic-green draws the leaves, plant-dried the stalk, paint-olive the buds and paperboard-brown the soil on the root. Processing it into dried leaves has no content field yet. The reference gives no longest side.

name: Cash register
description: A shop till with a keypad, a receipt printer and a small display on a post. Its cash drawer sits in the base, locked. It does not power on.
notes: 360 mm wide and deep and 300 mm tall: a charcoal body, a grey cash drawer with a finger pull and a key lock, a raked keypad of white number keys, grey function keys and a red total key, a receipt printer with paper at its slot, and a green display facing both ways on a post. The drawer is the container, so the pocket grid is a placeholder for coins and notes; prying the locked drawer open has no content field yet. glass-lens-green draws the display.
